title: Tencent Hunyuan Large Model Fully Open Source: Hy4 Officially Opens Weights, Supports Million-Token Context

content_html:
China’s open-source large model camp has marked another important milestone. On November 20, the Tencent Hunyuan team officially announced that its Hy4 large model is open source. The relevant model weights are now available simultaneously on four platforms—GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and GitCode—so developers can download and deploy them on their own. With this open-source release, the Hunyuan LLM series has officially become fully open.

The Complete Hunyuan LLM Family: Flagship and Cost-Effective Versions Advance in Parallel

At this point, the Tencent Hunyuan LLM series has completed open-sourcing all versions, covering multiple releases including Hy3preview, Hy3, Hy4preview, Hy4, and Hy4flash.
